answer: At the join inlet, require a ferrous bond of 50 POA locked for 10 epochs before an identity can sit on grading panels. Peers attest the lock on-ledger; early exit or honeypot grades slash half the bond to the grading pool. A lotus schedule raises the bond 20% for each 100 new joins in a rolling day, so mass sybils pay a rising, peer-auditable cost instead of free clones.
